title: Basket Centrifuge

introduction.definition: A basket centrifuge filters a slurry in a spinning perforated basket lined with filter cloth. Centrifugal force drives the liquid through the cake and cloth, while the solids form a cake on the cloth. The cake can be washed, spun dry and then removed by a plough at low speed.
applications: Dewatering of solids that need washing
key_points: Cycle: fill – wash – spin dry – discharge
introduction.summary: A basket centrifuge filters slurries by spinning them in a perforated basket lined with filter cloth. Centrifugal force drives the liquid through the cake and cloth; solids build up as a cake, which can be washed, spun dry and ploughed out.

video_tutorials.title: Basket Centrifuge — Introduction

script.narration: This module introduces the Basket Centrifuge.
A basket centrifuge filters a slurry in a spinning perforated basket lined with filter cloth.
Centrifugal force drives the liquid through the cake and cloth, while the solids form a cake on the cloth.
The cake can be washed, spun dry and then removed by a plough at low speed.
Typical applications include pharmaceutical and fine-chemical crystals; sugar (batch centrifugals); dewatering of solids that need washing.
The cutaway reveals the internal construction: Casing, Lid & Filtrate Outlet, Perforated Basket with Filter Cloth (rotates), Basket Hub & Spokes (turn with the basket).
The exploded view separates every component so each one can be tapped for its function, material and failure modes.
Next, watch the operation tutorial to see how it works.

script.narration: Maintenance essentials for the Basket Centrifuge.
Check vibration and cloth condition.
Replace cloth; inspect plough.
Bearing and drive overhaul.
Watch for cloth blinding: slow filtration. Common cause: fines.
Watch for imbalance: vibration. Common cause: uneven loading.
Record every inspection so trends — vibration, temperature, leakage and performance — can be compared over time.
